coverageMeaning: A source-family link identifies a related editable data unit. It does not replace the source illustration or promise identical defaults, original numeric measurements, surrounding layout or cropped variants. Existing source IDs and their SVG fragments remain available.

families.name: Monthly cohort prediction, four rows
families.sourceData: Native cell strings: four cohorts, three monthly columns and customer counts. Later source variants expose all text; 1232 is flattened.
families.limitations: Preserve the source spelling 758$ and each wrapper crop. Equivalent cell values do not imply identical illustrations.
